title: pvXMLPartitionedImageDataReader
body:
## pvXMLPartitionedImageDataReader

Reads partitioned VTK XML image data files (.pvti) into image data (vtkImageData) assembled from the .vti pieces the .pvti summary file lists, with the selected point and cell arrays and any field data. The VTK XML formats keep every array as written, so this is the natural way to reload data saved by ParaView, VTK or Schemaxis exports. Several file names form a time series. Use pvXMLImageDataReader or readImageData for a single .vti file.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The .pvti summary refers to .vti piece files, which must stay with it.
- Arrays left out of CellArrayStatus or PointArrayStatus are not read; name the arrays later nodes need.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `XMLPartitionedImageDataReader`. Identity: `sources/XMLPImageDataReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-centred arrays to read, i.e. values stored on the image cells (voxels) in the partitioned VTK XML image data file's CellData. Arrays not listed are skipped, saving memory and read time; an empty list reads the geometry without cell arrays. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the partitioned VTK XML image data format. The standard extension is .pvti. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the point-centred arrays to read, i.e. values stored at the image points in the partitioned VTK XML image data file's PointData. Arrays not listed are skipped, saving memory and read time; an empty list reads the geometry without point arrays. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `TimeArray` | Names the field-data array that holds the time value of each time step (ParaView's XML default is TimeValue). Choose the entry "None" to number the steps with the integers 0, 1, 2, ... instead of reading a time array. ParaView's own description calls that entry "Default", but the list's no-selection entry is "None". | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvXMLPartitionedImageDataReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
